witness.branch: Destination stopping within the designated place
witness.quote: a person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle in any such designated place.
witness.reason: A destination stop can occur within a device-designated place without contradicting the fixed road or control.
required_context: Establish device content, erection during the halt, authority, traffic purpose, statutory conformity and actual designation boundaries; device positions alone do not establish those boundaries.
Establish qualifying vehicle, the person's causal connection to the halt and actual position within the designated extent.
Observe traffic-conflict circumstances and officer or official-device directions; do not assume a necessary-halt exclusion.
Official device content, authority, placement and existence during the halt are established.

Record motion including momentary halts, purpose, actual passenger and merchandise activity, other traffic, conflicts and police or official-device directions. Do not assume or dismiss a necessary-halt exclusion.
Retain physical hazardous or congested-place facts and the unresolved legal characterization.
Supply physical facts concerning hazardous or congested character while preserving that legal characterization as unresolved.
The selected person causes a qualifying vehicle to halt within the established designated extent.
